title: UndeadPandemic
description: Survive the apocalypse, or become part of it.
body:
# 🧟 UndeadPandemic ### Transform your Minecraft world into a full-blown post-apocalyptic survival experience **Fight the infection. Purify your water. Survive the Blood Moon.** [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Server-005451?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/C5xuRNETjy) [![Docs](https://img.shields.io/badge/Documentation-005451?logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white)](https://docs.undeadpandemic.net/) [![Premium](https://img.shields.io/badge/Premium-£9.99%20lifetime-F5A623?logoColor=white)](https://www.undeadpandemic.net/premium/) **Paper • Spigot • Purpur**  |  **Built for 1.21**  |  **Latest: 3.2.1**
![UndeadPandemic Features](https://images.undeadpandemic.net/posters/undeadpandemic_poster.png) --- ## ☣️ Unleash the Apocalypse UndeadPandemic overhauls survival gameplay, plunging players into a relentless world where every decision matters. Water, food, and the infected are all vectors for the plague. Adapt fast, scavenge smarter, and stay one step ahead of the infection… or become part of it. This isn't just survival. **It's survival reimagined.** --- ## 💥 Features - 🧪 **Zombie Infection System** — Water, food, and zombies are all vectors. Stay clean, or become one of them. Configure symptom onset, infection duration, mutation severity, and transmission. - 🩸 **Zombie Guts Camouflage** — Smear yourself in zombie remains to become invisible to the horde… until it rains and washes it away. - 🌧️ **Environmental Reactions** — Rain extinguishes campfires, strips camouflage, and fills cauldrons. Survival means adaptation. - 🌕 **Blood Moon Events** *(Premium)* — Night events that make zombies faster, stronger, and relentless. Greater loot… if you survive. - 🥩 **Infected Livestock** — Even your animals may turn against you. Rotten flesh is only the beginning. - 💧 **Thirst & Dehydration** — Hunger isn't your only enemy. Dehydration weakens players until survival slips away. - ⛺ **Secure Camps** — Build from a humble tent and firelight up to a fortified stronghold with locked doors and defences. - 🏆 **Rewards & Integration** — Earn rewards for kills, hook into Vault economy, track stats via PlaceholderAPI, and protect regions with WorldGuard. --- ## 💎 Free vs Premium The free plugin is a complete apocalypse overhaul. Premium adds deeper server-owner control and exclusive challenge content — **one payment, lifetime access.** | Feature | 🧡 Free | 💎 Premium | |---|:---:|:---:| | Custom & vanilla zombie spawning | ✅ | ✅ | | Zombie behaviour config (sunburn, daylight spawn, door-breaking, name tags) | — | ✅ | | Spitting zombies attribute | — | ✅ | | Headshot-only kills | — | ✅ | | Thirst & dehydration system | ✅ Standard | ✅ Custom rates & buffers | | Blood Moon event | — | ✅ | | Enhanced horde types | — | ✅ | | Health / injury system (first-aid recovery) | — | ✅ | | Rainwater-filled cauldrons | — | ✅ | | Configurable animal scarcity | — | ✅ | | Wire Cutters & Zombie Mask (disguise items) | — | ✅ | | First aid items (Adrenaline, Analgesia, Antibiotics, Bandages, Kit) | ✅ | ✅ | | Infection, tainted crops, infected animals, water system | ✅ | ✅ | | All commands & PlaceholderAPI support | ✅ | ✅ | | Resource pack & 7 languages | ✅ | ✅ | | Early access to new features | — | ✅ | [**Buy Premium ➜**](https://www.undeadpandemic.net/premium/) --- ## 📷 Gallery ![Zombie Infection](https://images.undeadpandemic.net/posters/zombie-infection.png) *Drink at your own risk…* ![Blood Moon](https://images.undeadpandemic.net/posters/blood-moon.png) *Hope you brought a sword.* ![Zombie Guts Camouflage](https://images.undeadpandemic.net/posters/zombie-guts.png) *You're one of them… for now.* --- ## 📥 Get Started 1. Download the `.jar` from the **Files** tab above. 2. Drop it into your server's `/plugins` folder. 3. Restart the server and edit `config.yml` to taste. 4. Full setup guide: **[docs.undeadpandemic.net](https://docs.undeadpandemic.net/installation)** > 💎 **Premium** unlocks with a one-time licence — enter your API key and UUID in `config.yml`. No subscription. --- ## 🔌 Compatibility & Integrations **Minecraft:** Built for 1.21  |  **Servers:** Paper, Spigot, Purpur Works seamlessly alongside: - ✅ [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) — economy hooks - ✅ [WorldGuard](https://enginehub.org/worldguard/) — region protection - ✅ [WorldEdit](https://enginehub.org/worldedit/) — world tooling - ✅ [PlaceholderAPI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/placeholderapi.6245/) — live player data (`zombies killed`, `headshot kills`, `thirst`) --- ## 💬 Join the Community Need help, or want to show off your infected survival base? 👉 **[Join the UndeadPandemic Discord](https://discord.gg/C5xuRNETjy)** --- ## 📜 License Closed-source. Subject to the terms included with your download. ---
